$comment: Reviewed list of every external host that may appear in source. Rule 1: citizen data may only flow to `outbound` hosts (Indian). Everything else must be justified. scripts/egress-audit.ts fails on any host not listed here.

outbound.api.sarvam.ai: Sarvam AI (India) — text AI provider, only when SARVAM_API_KEY is set

optInForeign.exp.host: Expo push relay — only used when PUSH_DRIVER=expo AND exp.host is added to EGRESS_ALLOWLIST; payload carries no personal data (M17)
optInForeign.tile.openstreetmap.org: Development-only default map tiles (NODE_ENV=development); production must set MAP_TILE_URL (§11)

userInitiatedLinks.www.openstreetmap.org: Web fallback for 'open in maps' — opened only when the user taps it; Sankalp sends nothing
userInitiatedLinks.airquality.cpcb.gov.in: CPCB national AQI (Government of India), opened by the user from the home screen

nonNetwork.react.dev: URL inside an error message string
nonNetwork.leafletjs.com: Licence header comment in the bundled Leaflet build
nonNetwork.bugs.chromium.org: Comment inside the bundled Leaflet build
nonNetwork.bugzilla.mozilla.org: Comment inside the bundled Leaflet build
nonNetwork.apps.apple.com: Static store link on the fallback landing page (user-initiated)
nonNetwork.play.google.com: Static store link on the fallback landing page (user-initiated)
nonNetwork.sankalp.uk.gov.in: Intended production domain placeholder in docs/templates
